<div class="container">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-sm-12 text-center">
<h2>How it works</h2>
<p class="subheading">Finding great voice over has never been faster or easier</p>
<a class="btn btn-primary" href="/how-it-works">Learn more</a></div>
</div>
<div class="row how-row">
<div class="col-sm-6 col-sm-push-6"><img alt="" class="how-image lazy" data-src="https://static.voices.com/assets/uploads/client/home-submit-your-job.svg" src=""/></div>
<div class="col-sm-6 col-sm-pull-6 col-md-5 how-text-col">
<h2>Submit Your Job Posting</h2>
<p>Receive high-quality auditions (often in minutes) and a quote that fits within your budget. If you have a custom script, you’ll hear your project come to life through custom auditions that read a sample of your copy - all for free.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row how-row">
<div class="col-sm-6"><img alt="" class="how-image lazy" data-src="https://static.voices.com/assets/uploads/client/home-select-the-voice-actor.svg" src=""/></div>
<div class="col-sm-6 col-md-5 col-md-offset-1 how-text-col">
<h2>Select the Voice Actor</h2>
<p>Hire in one-click. While the final voice over files are being prepared, your payment will be held securely in Voices.com’s SurePay™ Escrow Account. Throughout the process, communications are confidential through our platform.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="row how-row">
<div class="col-sm-6 col-sm-push-6"><img alt="" class="how-image lazy" data-src="https://static.voices.com/assets/uploads/client/home-complete-your-project.svg" src=""/></div>
<div class="col-sm-6 col-sm-pull-6 col-md-5 how-text-col">
<h2>Complete Your Project</h2>
<p>Once you’re satisfied with the voice over and have received the final files, it’s time to release your payment to the voice actor, by simply hitting ‘Release Payment.’ Voila! All that’s left is to release your final project to the world.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2 class="text-center">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
<div aria-multiselectable="true" class="panel-group" id="accordion" role="tablist">
<div class="panel panel-default">
<div class="panel-heading" id="headingOne" role="tab">
<h3 class="panel-title"><a aria-controls="collapseOne" aria-expanded="true" class="panel-btn collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" href="#collapseOne" role="button">What is voice over? </a></h3>
</div>
<div aria-labelledby="headingOne" class="panel-collapse collapse" id="collapseOne" role="tabpanel">
<div class="panel-body">A 'voice over' is an audio narration provided by a voice actor for a project or production. Voice over plays a significant role in marketing, advertising, learning, broadcast, gaming and many other industries to convey brand messaging, improve retention, bring characters to life, and generally create more meaningful connections with the intended audience.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="panel panel-default">
<div class="panel-heading" id="headingTwo" role="tab">
<h3 class="panel-title"><a aria-controls="collapseTwo" aria-expanded="false" class="panel-btn collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" href="#collapseTwo" role="button">How much does voice over cost? </a></h3>
</div>
<div aria-labelledby="headingTwo" class="panel-collapse collapse" id="collapseTwo" role="tabpanel">
<div class="panel-body">Voice over rates vary, and depend on the characteristics of your project such as the length of your script and category of work (e.g. TV, radio, online video, etc.), as well as the particular voice actor you select. However, creating an account and posting a job on Voices.com are both free. Learn more about <a href="/resources/rates">voice over rates</a> and start <a href="/signup">posting jobs to find the best voice for your project</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="panel panel-default">
<div class="panel-heading" id="headingThree" role="tab">
<h3 class="panel-title"><a aria-controls="collapseThree" aria-expanded="false" class="panel-btn collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" href="#collapseThree" role="button">How do I hire a voice actor? </a></h3>
</div>
<div aria-labelledby="headingThree" class="panel-collapse collapse" id="collapseThree" role="tabpanel">
<div class="panel-body">Start by creating your free account and filling in a job posting. Include information about your project, the type of voice actor you'd like, and a small portion of your script for voice actors to use for their auditions to you. Our proprietary VoiceMatch™ algorithm will then work behind the scenes to invite the best suited talent from our global talent pool. Once you hear the right voice for your project, simply click 'Hire.'</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="panel panel-default">
<div class="panel-heading" id="headingFour" role="tab">
<h3 class="panel-title"><a aria-controls="collapseFour" aria-expanded="false" class="panel-btn collapsed" data-toggle="collapse" href="#collapseFour" role="button">What makes a good voice over? </a></h3>
</div>
<div aria-labelledby="headingFour" class="panel-collapse collapse" id="collapseFour" role="tabpanel">
<div class="panel-body">A good voice over effectively conveys the intended message and meaning, with the right tone, style and words. The delivery of the script should be clear and easy to understand, be enjoyable to listen to, and generally be consistent with the brand that the particular project is representing. Learn more about <a href="/blog/understanding-how-to-express-your-brand-voice/">building your brand through a great voice over</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
